address: 9 Castle House, South Great George's Street, Dublin City, D02 WK13, Ireland
bio: A striking, pop art-style mural frames the kitchen pass at this casual, trendy and thoroughly lively restaurant. The airy interior features whitewashed brick walls, some counter seating and loud hip-hop. Start with ‘bites’ and small plates to share, before moving onto the concise selection of main courses cooked over charcoal. Fabulous produce like Wicklow venison and wild brill on the bone yields bold, satisfying flavours. Make sure you finish with the ‘Irish coffee’, their take on a tiramisu....
